title: Fire Doors
activity: Fire door leaf, frame, gaps, seals, ironmongery and signage
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Certification label on top of the leaf present and undamaged?
Gaps even all round – head, jambs and meeting stiles 2–4 mm; threshold 8–10 mm max (3 mm if smoke-rated "s" door without a threshold seal)?

guide.title: Fire door gaps – maximums
rows: 3 mm max, unless a drop-down / threshold smoke seal closes it
£1 coin ≈ 3 mm – should slide in, not rattle
guide.note: The door manufacturer's data sheet / field of application is the final word – a door certified for 3 mm max fails at 4 mm. Check the 's' on the door label: smoke-rated doors need the 3 mm threshold or a smoke seal.
guide.src: BS 8214:2016 (9.5.3); BWF Fire Door Alliance; Atlantic ITP 10.2; Errigal riser door checklist

questions.q: Frame fixings the right number and position, frame-to-wall gap filled?
Frame-to-wall mastic at least 10 mm deep?
